name: Sour bamboo shoot
summary: Thai cooks in Pù Luông sour the forest bamboo shoot so it keeps all year, then cook it into a fish soup.
howToEat: In a fish soup with onion, fish sauce, salt, and pepper.
where: The Thai table in the valley.
seoTitle: Sour bamboo shoot in Pu Luong — with fish soup
seoDescription: Măng chua is the soured forest shoot Thai cooks keep all year and cook into fish soup.
